'''Joran Wostikian''' was the former [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hashaulh]].

==Biography==
At some point in time, Joran Wostikian served as the president for Hashaulh, an Outer Rim planet. Wostikian and his [[Joran Wostikian's wife|wife]] had a son named [[Soltan Wostikian|Soltan]]. By [[19 BBY]], Wostikian and his wife perished in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident, and the [[Vice President/Legends|vice president]], [[Jettero Heler]], took over as president of Hashaulh and adopted their son Soltan.<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />
